text:
Priya R: Quick sync — LumenHealth wants a 3-week POC focused on intake triage + rerank. Need EU-only data plane and explainability on decisions.
Liam (AE): Customer estimate ~100k reqs/day, wants ballpark pricing for Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Prefers Private (VPC) but timeline could force Dedicated.
Carmen (Solutions): MVP endpoints proposed: POST /triage -> {intent, confidence, reasons}; POST /rerank -> list->best; optional POST /embeddings for similarity. Prioritize triage first.
Noah S (Infra): Security must-haves: EU data residency, customer-managed KMS, SCIM SSO, 90d audit export, DPA + SOC2 addendum. Need infra contact + IP allowlist by Monday.
Priya R: Non-functional targets suggested: triage top1 >=85% on 1k eval; p95 <800ms, p99 <1200ms; explanation present for >=90% decisions.
Carmen (Solutions): Eval plan sketch: 50-case smoke (week1), 1k labeled eval (week2). Include adversarial cases, truncated inputs, multilingual (EN/FR/DE/ES). Run 3 model variants, 5 seeds.
Liam (AE): They also asked about support during POC — propose 8 SE hours/week + on-call during demo.
Noah S: For Private fallback plan: if capacity short, route to Dedicated EU pool; test failover and surface additional latency in reports.
Carmen (Solutions): Prompt template (short):
System: You are a medical intake assistant. Return JSON {intent, confidence, reasons[]}.
User: <intake text>
Priya R: Draft evaluation weights: quality 50%, latency 25%, cost 15%, explainability 10%. Will share slide for execs.
Noah S: Pricing rule-of-thumb: Hosted = lowest setup, higher unit cost; Dedicated = mid setup, reserved commit, lower unit cost; Private = highest setup + infra fee, best unit cost at scale + compliance add-on. I'll draft ranges.
Legal-Bot: Reminder: include list of subprocessors for DPA and copy legal@redwood on DPA questions.
Priya R: Action items: Carmen -> eval harness + prompts (48h); Noah -> security checklist + pricing ranges (72h); Liam -> collect infra contact, IP allowlist, burst profile (24h). Calendar invite set for kickoff.
Liam (AE): I'll confirm burst patterns and subprocessor list with customer and post an update.
Priya R: Thanks everyone — aim to have a one-slide ballpark for procurement by EOD tomorrow.
